defect.description: A shadowed caller byteLength could pass the initial size test, causing new Uint8Array(input) to allocate the full actual over-cap view before the strict parser eventually refused it. Throwing byteLength accessors also refused valid genuine offset views.

repair: Capture the native TypedArray byteLength getter and Uint8Array set operation using the existing RegistryService pattern. Check the actual view against unchanged 65536-byte cap before allocating a bounded owned array; copy only intrinsic offset/range and catch malformed/detached views as fixed MALFORMED. Public signatures/rejection codes remain unchanged.

verification.redObserved: Bounded 65537-byte view with shadowed byteLength allocated one owned view before rejection; bounded offset view with throwing accessor returned MALFORMED.

greenObserved.validPoisonedOffsetView: accepted with exact expected terms; no length/iterator/constructor accessor calls; all caller backing bytes unchanged

scope: Only these two root-admitted paths changed in this slice. No huge allocation, external target, RPC, wallet, spending or production activation.
The T88 wallet pair and its frozen packet/manifest are unchanged. Original29-file T38-C audit inventory hashes are retained, with the two authorized repairs recorded separately.
No whole suite or commit; root independent review remains required.
